title: Creator monetisation and payments
summary: Mobile commerce experiences that help creators turn audience attention into sustainable income.
problem: Creator businesses need payment and monetisation flows that feel simple on mobile while safely coordinating identity, checkout, fulfilment and platform constraints.
role: Worked across product, design and platform partners to shape and ship creator-facing mobile experiences spanning Wallet, Digital Products, Shop and Bookings.
technicalComplexity: Coordinating native mobile, React Native and backend-owned workflows
Designing resilient transaction states and recoverable user journeys
Keeping multiple commerce surfaces consistent as the product evolved
decisions: Modelled long-running states explicitly so progress, failure and recovery remained understandable
Reused shared mobile patterns while preserving the needs of each monetisation product
Instrumented critical steps so teams could reason about completion and drop-off
outcomes: Expanded the ways creators can earn directly from their Linktree
Created reusable mobile patterns for future commerce experiences
Shipped public product experiences without exposing confidential business metrics

title: Launching and scaling Linktree's Mobile app
summary: Building a cross-platform mobile foundation and evolving it into a product surface used by creators worldwide.
problem: Linktree needed to bring core creator workflows to iOS and Android quickly without creating two disconnected product and engineering systems.
role: Contributed to the original React Native launch and continued evolving onboarding, profile editing, commerce and creator workflows as the app scaled.
technicalComplexity: Sharing product logic while respecting iOS and Android platform behaviour
Evolving architecture while continuously shipping new product surfaces
Maintaining a coherent experience across web-owned and mobile-owned workflows
decisions: Used React Native to share product capabilities while retaining native escape hatches
Organised code around product modules to keep ownership and change boundaries clear
Treated performance, release safety and observability as product requirements
outcomes: Helped establish Linktree's first consumer mobile application
Supported continued expansion into onboarding, editing and monetisation workflows
Shared the team's React Native approach through a public engineering talk
